mechanism: Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase nicotine levels; both drugs increase dopamine and norepinephrine, elevating seizure risk and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for increased nicotine side effects (tremor, tachycardia, hypertension) and seizure risk; counsel on smoking cessation as bupropion's indicated use; ensure seizure threshold is not compromised.
